title: Parabolic Anderson Model on Sierpinski Gasket
page_description: Interactive parabolic Anderson model on the Sierpinski gasket with a continuous localized initial profile of unit mass.
model_caption: One realization of the Itô parabolic Anderson model with Neumann boundary conditions and space–time white noise. The initial condition is a nonnegative continuous harmonic hat of total mass one, positive on a localized region and zero elsewhere.
reading_caption: The visualization illustrates positivity beyond the initial support at positive times. Use ln u to reveal small positive values, or switch to u to inspect spatial peaks.
equation_accessible_text: The time derivative of u equals kappa times the Neumann gasket Laplacian of u plus lambda times u times space-time white noise.
